name: kiwoo-web-app-publisher
description: Preview and publish pure-frontend HTML apps to Kiwoo drafts, with an explicit preview-then-confirm workflow.

interface.longDescription: Kiwoo Web App Publisher turns a pure-frontend project or a single static HTML page into a Kiwoo draft. It builds one self-contained HTML entry, runs a pre-publish quality gate, creates a 10-minute preview URL, and waits for the user's explicit confirmation before saving to Kiwoo Drafts. Publishing never makes the work publicly live; public release remains a separate user action in the Kiwoo workspace.
defaultPrompt: Preview this pure-frontend HTML app with Kiwoo.
Publish my static web app to Kiwoo Drafts after I confirm the preview.
